title: Spawn Needs Ownership
goal: Pass data into a spawned task without lifetime errors.
hints: Returning an impl Future + 'static requires the future to own all captured variables.
Use the move keyword on the async block to transfer ownership of s into the future.
explanation: Returning an `impl Future + 'static` requires that the future owns all captured data. A plain `async { s.len() }` borrows `s` from the function parameter frame, failing the `'static` bound with `E0373`. Adding `move` to make `async move { s.len() }` gives the future full ownership of `s`. Writing `move ||` creates a closure instead of a future, which fails with `E0277` because closures do not implement `Future`.
